meta.name: automated-learning
meta.description: Self-evolution skill — captures what worked, what failed, and what to change after every non-trivial run. Produces routing patches, registry hygiene checks, and paste-ready Learning Notes for run_log.jsonl. Mandatory post-run step for STANDARD, DEEP, and DREAM_INNOVATION modes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据运行记录自动沉淀经验,产出路由优化补丁与学习笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次跑完任务后想自动沉淀经验并让系统越用越顺
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run agent tasks regularly and want the system to learn and improve from each run.

howto.what: 完成一次任务后，自动记录哪些做法有效、哪些失败、下一步改什么；生成三条路由规则补丁，检查技能目录的注册表是否规范，并输出一段可直接粘贴到 run_log.jsonl 的 JSON 学习笔记。
howto.when: 在 STANDARD、DEEP、DREAM_INNOVATION 任一模式运行结束后，或出现技能选择错误、验证失败、YAML 解析失败等异常时触发。

say.text: 把刚才跑完的任务写入学习笔记
say.note: 会生成 JSON 学习笔记供粘贴。

say.text: 检查技能注册表并生成路由补丁
say.note: 输出路由修正和卫生检查结果。

say.text: 分析这次失败，记录要改的规则
say.note: 捕捉信号并产出三要点。

howto.what_en: After each task run, records what worked, what failed, and what to change; produces a routing patch with 3 items, checks skill registry hygiene, and outputs a ready-to-paste JSON Learning Note for run_log.jsonl.
howto.when_en: Triggers after a STANDARD, DEEP, or DREAM_INNOVATION run completes, or after a routing error, verification failure, or suspected YAML parse failure.

say_en.text: Log the just-finished task into the learning notes.
Check skill registry and generate a routing patch.
say_en.note: Outputs routing fixes and hygiene results.

say_en.text: Analyze this failure and record the rule to change.
say_en.note: Captures signals and produces three key points.
